records.name: Generic EU Green Claims / Greenwashing Scanner
records.reason: The concept is not new to the corpus and the scanner/substantiation market is already crowded with free and low-cost products.

records.name: Cross-Border EU Succession / Inheritance Advice Tool
records.reason: Bespoke, high-liability professional advice problem with strong official information and lawyer-backed substitutes.
records.officialSubstitute: Your Europe inheritance guidance, European e-Justice country pages, European Certificate of Succession forms, and free Your Europe Advice

records.salvagedCapability: None within personalized legal advice. A neutral professional-referral or document-routing product would be a separate hypothesis.

evidence.claim: Last habitual residence generally determines the authority/law, with an explicit nationality-law choice available
Denmark and Ireland do not participate in Regulation 650/2012
Spanish common law reserves two thirds for children/descendants and Spain has multiple succession-law systems

records.name: PPWR DIY Registration Guide / Winner Replacement
records.reason: The forcing function is real, but the same-day pan-EU marketplace-delisting claim is overstated, the penalty and authorised-representative claims contain material errors, the cheap self-service tier is occupied, the Czech English-guidance gap is false, and the corpus already contains the PackGate/PackProof family.
records.officialSubstitute: National registers and producer-responsibility organisations, Commission guidance, marketplace EPR workflows, and EKO-KOM's English onboarding materials
records.buyerCanDoNothing: Use official guidance and a low-cost self-service product, or narrow sales to registered markets until registration is complete.
records.salvagedCapability: Test country routing and packaging-evidence preflight inside the existing PackGate/PackProof staged family.

evidence.claim: Regulation (EU) 2025/40 generally applies from 12 August 2026
Article 44 requires per-Member-State producer registration but phases in the new harmonised national registers after an implementing act
Online platforms must obtain registration information and self-certification before permitting covered producers to use their services
An Amazon-commissioned study found 64 unique registration fields across ten Member States
Germany's Packaging Act provides distribution prohibitions and administrative fines up to EUR 200,000 for specified violations
EKO-KOM provides English onboarding, forms, reporting information, downloads, and a public client list

records.name: CRA Article 14 Cheap Reporting Readiness Guide
records.canonicalRelation: idea-401 CRA ReachLedger; CRA Clock; CRA Incident Compiler
records.reason: The September reporting obligation is real, but the prompt materially overstates SaaS scope, misses the final-report stage, treats SBOM work as part of the immediate 2026 reporting duty, overlooks direct cheap and free workflow competitors, and duplicates the portfolio's existing CRA family.
records.officialSubstitute: Commission CRA guidance and FAQs, ENISA SRP guidance, the official Single Reporting Platform, and coordinating CSIRTs
records.buyerCanDoNothing: Use the Commission and ENISA material plus a free template builder and an existing incident-response process; obtain counsel for edge-case scope decisions.
records.salvagedCapability: Merge a timed incident-evidence rehearsal into idea-401 / CRA Clock / CRA Incident Compiler, covering awareness, trigger classification, affected-product reach, mitigation, user notice, and all reporting stages.

evidence.claim: Article 14 applies from 11 September 2026, with 24-hour, 72-hour, and later final-report stages
Standalone SaaS is not automatically a product with digital elements; qualifying remote data processing can be within a product boundary
ENISA says the SRP will be operational by 11 September 2026 and has published user guidance
Vexwatch advertises a EUR 49 small-team CRA document pack including a reporting runbook and scope memo
CRA Report offers browser-local deadline calculation, missing-field checks, and staged SRP content
CVD Portal offers a free Article 14 notification template builder
Acuna explicitly offers Article 14 fields, reporting clocks, ownership, evidence trail, and manual SRP preparation
